london.note: London's freshest New York news in print each day.

liverpool.note: Steamers from New York reported arrived at Liverpool, each with news to its sailing day; 1 May - 31 July only. News telegraphed from the Irish landing ports reached Liverpool about a day before the ship, and from 1 August New York news came by cable; there is no Liverpool-dated evidence for either yet, so those days are null.
